paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for three different methods: Consistency-CE, Consistency-Uni, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU," also with a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 32, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot includes three lines representing different methods. The purple line with circular markers follows a dashed style, starting at a BLEU score of 19 at an AL of 0 and ending at approximately 31 at an AL of 8, showing an overall upward trend with a sharp increase initially. The green line with square markers follows a solid style, beginning at a BLEU score of about 25 at AL 2 and steadily increasing to above 32 at AL 8. The red line with star markers also follows a solid style, ranging from a BLEU score of about 26 at AL 2 to slightly above 32 at AL 8, with a consistent upward trend. The red line intersects with green line at an x-value of 7. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
